template.title: The Secret Detour
template.summary: A bored ride becomes a magical adventure when a secret turn reveals a giant animal and a sparkling souvenir.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] stared out the window of the [[slot_vehicle]] and felt a little bored.
The driver, [[slot_driver]], was humming a song while the road stretched gray and plain.
Suddenly, the vehicle turned onto a street that wasn't on any map, and the sky turned pink.
[[slot_child]] pressed their face to the glass and saw a giant [[slot_animal]] floating gracefully past the window.
The animal waved, and tiny sparkles fell into the car, making the seats sparkle.
Inside, the driver laughed and said, "We're on a secret adventure!"
The vehicle zoomed through a field of [[slot_fantasy_sight]] for just a minute, and everything felt like a dream.
Then the road became ordinary again, but the vehicle headed back to the usual route.
When they arrived, [[slot_child]] held a [[slot_souvenir]] that glowed like a star, proof of the detour.
Everyone in the vehicle cheered, and the trip felt wonderful and full of wonder.
